sentence: aham te manasā manaḥ cakṣuḥ gṛhṇāmi cakṣuṣā
tatra tatra eva vividham prajānām jāyate bhayam
pitaraḥ tasya tam māsam tasmin rajasi śerate
labhante sukham aṅgāni balam varṇaḥ ca vardhate
sa kathayati na aham kāmaiḥ arthī
snānena tatra pāpāni naśyanti eva na saṃśayaḥ
manasā ca eva hi vācā ca yajñaḥ vartate
indraḥ ca hi eva chandāṃsi ca rātrim vahanti
karmaṇā manasā vācā saḥ yāti paramām gatim
vistareṇa na śaknoti bṛhaspatiḥ api dvijāḥ
indraḥ asi tāta bhūtānām sarveṣām na atra saṃśayaḥ
ekaḥ tvam asi lokānām devānām ca sanātanaḥ
kumāram eva aham varam vṛṇe iti
yajñe ca eva tat paśuṣu ca pratitiṣṭhati
tat evam devi devānām api santi na siddhayaḥ
prāṇaḥ eva apāne juhoti apānaḥ prāṇe
svena eva tat chandasā agnim stauti
agne mahān asi brāhmaṇa bhārata iti
brahmaṇā eva tat devebhyaḥ haviḥ prayacchati
sarveṇa eva tat vācaḥ vikāreṇa devebhyaḥ haviḥ prayacchati
saha eva annādyena svargam lokam eti
prapadye bhavataḥ rūpam tat viṣṇoḥ paramam padam
śive mama pure devi jāyante tatra mānavāḥ
teṣām dadāmi tat sthānam ānandam paramam padam
ādityānām aham viṣṇuḥ vasūnām asmi pāvakaḥ
satyena lokān jayati satyam tat paramam padam
tatra nārāyaṇaḥ devaḥ nareṇa āste sanātanaḥ
ekaikaḥ eva manyate aham rājā aham rājā iti
viprāṇām karma doṣeṇa prajānām jāyate bhayam
tadā tu alpena kālena siddhim gacchanti mānavāḥ
prāṇāya ca eva rudrāya juhoti amṛtam uttamam
mānavāḥ munayaḥ ca eva sarve liṅgam yajanti ca
carāmaḥ vipulam dharmam teṣām ca aṃśaḥ asti dharmāt
brāhmaṇāḥ eva kurvanti nityam eva yuge yuge
tam manye aham pitaram mātaram ca
ekayā prajayā pitroḥ mātaram te dadāmi aham
ekaikaḥ ca eva puruṣaḥ tat prayacchati bhojanam
santi mama maṇayaḥ ca eva dhanāni vividhāni ca
brāhmaṇāḥ guravaḥ ca eva jānanti api ca devatāḥ
śrīmatām ca api jānāsi rājñām dharmam sanātanam
tataḥ yajñāḥ pravartante dharmāḥ ca vividhāḥ kriyāḥ
tathā eva bhagavān somaḥ nakṣatraiḥ saha gacchati
pādau śūdrāḥ bhajante mama vikrameṇa krameṇa ca
sukhāni dharmam artham ca svargam ca labhate naraḥ
rocate mama vacaḥ kṛtsnam brāhmaṇānām na saṃśayaḥ
tatra gacchanti rājānaḥ brāhmaṇāḥ ca tataḥ tataḥ
balāni teṣām vīrāṇām āgacchanti tataḥ tataḥ
aham indraḥ asmi devānām lokānām ca tathā īśvaraḥ
kṛṣṇāya mahate nityam dharmaḥ dhārayati prajāḥ
jānanti kuravaḥ sarve rājānaḥ ca eva pārthivāḥ
namaḥ dharmāya mahate dharmaḥ dhārayati prajāḥ
jīvitam bahu manye aham jīvitam hi adya durlabham
sarvasmin mānuṣe loke vetti ekaḥ hi dhanaṃjayaḥ
arjunam ca api kaunteyam sadā rakṣati keśavaḥ
dhṛtarāṣṭrasya manye aham na api kṛṣṇasya pāṇḍavaḥ
puruṣe puruṣe buddhiḥ sā sā bhavati śobhanā
saḥ aham adya mahādevam prapadye śaraṇam prabhum
sarveṣām eva varṇānām na adharme ramate manaḥ
alpena api hi sainyena mahīm jayati pārthivaḥ
ādityāt jāyate vṛṣṭiḥ vṛṣṭyāḥ annam tataḥ prajāḥ
tatra devāḥ prayacchanti rājyāni ca dhanāni ca
na mama surāḥ prayacchanti bhāgam yajñasya dharmāt
evam guṇāḥ prakṛtyāḥ jāyante ca na santi ca
na ca indriyāṇi paśyanti manaḥ eva atra paśyati
cakṣuḥ paśyati rūpāṇi manasā tu na cakṣuṣā
karmaṇā manasā vācā viṣṇum eva yajanti te
kṣetram ca tapasām śreṣṭham paśyāmi āśramam uttamam
tasya eva ca prasādena bhaktiḥ utpadyate nṛṇām
ardham pāpasya harati puruṣasya iha karmaṇaḥ
aśvinoḥ ca eva vahneḥ ca prītiḥ bhavati sarpiṣā
sidhyanti arthāḥ sadā tasya kāryāṇi vividhāni ca
dhārayanti prajāḥ ca eva payasā haviṣā tathā
yamasya viṣayam ghoram martyaḥ lokaḥ prapadyate
sahitaḥ brāhmaṇena iha kṣatriyaḥ rakṣati prajāḥ
tayā na viṣayam manye sarvaḥ vā viṣayaḥ mama
ājyasya ājyam asi haviṣaḥ haviḥ satyasya satyam
tat eva indriyam vīryam tejaḥ āpnoti
yāvān eva paśuḥ tasmin āyuḥ dadhāti
na tatra sūryaḥ tapati na ca jānanti mānavāḥ
saḥ siddhim labhate nityam satyam satyam na saṃśayaḥ
na ca tat svargam lokam yāti
na pitā vardhate na mātā iti
na kāraṇasya sadṛśam kāryam iti upapadyate
tasya manasaḥ akṣaiḥ yogāt jñānam utpadyate
tathā anyat api trividham duḥkham bhavati
tat sarvam jāyate bhasma vajrasya eva prabhāvāt
jyeṣṭhāyām asi mama patnyām sadṛśāyām sadṛśaḥ sutaḥ
sadā sukham na jānāmi duḥkham eva sadā vanam
vipulām ca mama prītim sthirām jānāsi rāghave
manaḥ hi hetuḥ sarveṣām indriyāṇām pravartate
te yānti paramam lokam tatra tīrthe na saṃśayaḥ
tīrthasya abhimukhaḥ nityam jāyate na atra saṃśayaḥ
yāvataḥ tatra tīrthe tu vṛkṣān paśyanti mānavāḥ
nārī naraḥ tathā api evam labhate kāmam uttamam
yāvān eva puruṣaḥ tasmin yaśaḥ dadhāti
yāvān eva yajñaḥ tasya śiraḥ saṃbharati
tat aham api evam eva bravīmi
pṛthivyām avyayaḥ dehaḥ bhavati eva na saṃśayaḥ
tvam agne gṛhapatiḥ iti adhvaryuḥ gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāḥ vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ ca eva yajanti tam
tasmin āyuṣi tena eva karmaṇā bhogaḥ sampadyate iti
tat savituḥ vṛṇīmahe vayam devasya bhojanam
sa kṛtsnaḥ eva devānām haviḥ bhavati
saha eva prathamau grahau gṛhṇītaḥ saha uttamau
rasāt hi retaḥ sambhavati retasaḥ paśavaḥ
amṛtam āyuḥ hiraṇyam tat amṛte āyuṣi pratitiṣṭhati
kṣatram ca tat viśam ca karoti
śiraḥ ca tat ātmānam ca karoti
tatra hi sā sarvā kṛtsnā bhavati
tasya ādityam eva tejaḥ gacchati vāyum prāṇaḥ
śuciḥ tvam asi priyaḥ na mitraḥ
tvam viśvasya jagataḥ cakṣuḥ indra asi cakṣuṣaḥ
